Assemble with SPAdes (CLI)

A concise command-line recipe for assembling reads with SPAdes.

Install

# Install SPAdes via conda (recommended)
conda create -n spades -c bioconda spades -y
conda activate spades

Run (paired-end)

spades.py \
  -1 R1.fq.gz \
  -2 R2.fq.gz \
  -o outdir \
  --threads 16 \
  --memory 64

Outputs

outdir/contigs.fasta

💡 Tip: Adjust --threads and --memory to your node resources (e.g., on HPC).
